title: Eternal Decks
components: 64 Eternal Cards (8 unique character decks of 8 cards each)
setup: Select a Stage sheet (Stage 1 for beginner play) and place it face-up on the table.
Each player receives their starting 5-card personal deck and draws an opening hand.
Place the chosen Eternal character decks in face-up supply rows.
Construct the 3-row central Field area and place the initial Jewel supply nearby.
Review the specific stage conditions and environmental restrictions.
procedure: On your turn, you must take exactly 1 of the following actions:
Action 1 - Play a Card to the Field: Place a card into 1 of the 3 Field rows. Crucial placement rule: adjacent cards in any row or column cannot share the same color or the same numerical value.
Action 2 - Play a Card to the River: Place a resource card into the shared river reserve to save it for teammates or prepare future combos.
Action 3 - Generate a Jewel: Discard a card to gain a Jewel token from the supply (used to cancel negative curses or activate special stage abilities).
Action 4 - Aid a Teammate: Pass a card to an ally without speaking about its value or power.
endGame: Victory Condition: Complete all goals indicated on the active Stage sheet before any player runs out of legal actions.
Defeat Condition: The team immediately loses if any player is required to take an action on their turn but has no legal move available.
⚖️ Tie-Breaker: Cooperative game (all players share collective victory or defeat).
notes: Strict Limited Communication: You may never reveal the values, colors, or names of cards currently held in your hand.
Spatial Constraints: Always verify both orthogonal neighbors (color and number) before completing a card placement in the Field.
Jewel Management: Do not stockpile Jewels unnecessarily; use them early to mitigate devastating Eternal curses.
